name: constructorNullTypesThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because the types array must not be null.

name: constructorNullValuesThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because the values array must not be null.

name: constructorMismatchedLengthThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because the values array must be the same length as the types array.

name: constructorNullTypeInArrayThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because the types array must not contain null at any index.

name: constructorWrongOrderThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because types must be in order from largest to smallest duration.

name: constructorDuplicateTypeThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because types array must not contain duplicate fields.

name: constructorEmptyArraysSuccess
expected: Successfully constructs an empty Partial with UTC ISO chronology.

name: constructorValidSingleFieldSuccess
expected: Successfully constructs a Partial with a single valid field and value using default ISO UTC chronology.

name: constructorValidMultipleFieldsSuccess
input: types = [DateTimeFieldType.year(), DateTimeFieldType.monthOfYear(), DateTimeFieldType.dayOfMonth()], values = [2023, 6, 15], chronology = null
expected: Successfully constructs a Partial with year, monthOfYear, and dayOfMonth in correct descending order.

name: constructorExplicitChronologySuccess
expected: Successfully constructs a Partial using the provided explicit chronology.

name: constructorInvalidFieldValueThrowsException
expected: Throws an exception during chronology validation because month value 13 is out of range (1-12).
